items.title: 駭客用3套AI工具大規模攻擊電商，竊取超過60萬筆信用卡資料

items.title: 提示詞注入仍難可靠防範，澳洲通訊局公佈AI代理許可權控管原則
items.summary: 澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）發布代理型AI安全指引，警告目前仍沒有完全可靠的技術方法可以防範大型語言模型（LLM）將外部內容解讀成指令的提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）。ASD因此建議企業在部署代理型AI時，不應只依賴LLM本身的安全機制，還需限制AI代理存取資源的範圍及可執行的操作，降低提示詞注入造成的影響。

items.title: ChatGPT Voice gets closer to "Her" with email, calendar, and Slack access
items.summary: ChatGPT Voice now runs on OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna models and can tap into plugins like email, calendar, and Slack. Users can manage appointments, send emails, or build websites just by talking. The update moves OpenAI closer to the everyday AI assistant Sam Altman has long compared to the one in the sci-fi film "Her." The article ChatGPT Voice gets closer to "Her" with email, calendar, and Slack access appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT Voice 現在運行於 OpenAI's 全新 GPT-6 Astra、Sol 和 Luna 模型上，並可串接電子郵件、行事曆和 Slack 等外掛程式。使用者只要透過對話就能管理預約、傳送電子郵件或建置網站。這項更新讓 OpenAI 更接近 Sam Altman 長期以來將其比擬為科幻電影《她》（Her）中的那種日常 AI 助理。相關文章 ChatGPT Voice gets closer to "Her" with email, calendar, and Slack access 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Google's new Flash TTS models let you design AI voices from scratch using text descriptions
items.summary: Google is introducing two new text-to-speech models, Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS, which support more than 100 languages. Flash TTS can create new voices from text descriptions, and both models let users add stage directions to individual lines and generate two-voice dialogue from a single script. A voice cloning feature can build a voice profile from a 30-second sample. The article Google's new Flash TTS models let you design AI voices from scratch using text descriptions appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google 正在推出兩個全新的文字轉語音模型：Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 與 Flash-Lite TTS，支援超過 100 種語言。Flash TTS 可以根據文字描述建立新的聲音，且這兩個模型都允許使用者在個別行中加入舞臺指示，並從單一劇本產生雙人對話。聲音複製功能則能透過 30 秒的樣本建立聲音設定檔。相關文章 Google's new Flash TTS models let you design AI voices from scratch using text descriptions 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter
items.summary: Anthropic employee Jackson Kernion explains why newer Claude models write so oddly. Optimizing for math, code, and technical explanations aimed at other AI models has created a style that sounds like "overly-dense info dumps" to humans. Opus 5.5 tries to fix this, but Opus 4.6 remains unmatched as a pure writing model. The article Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 員工 Jackson Kernion 解釋了為什麼較新的 Claude 模型寫作風格如此奇特。為了針對其他 AI 模型進行數學、程式碼和技術解釋的最佳化，造就了一種對人類而言聽起來像是「過度密集的資訊傾倒」的風格。Opus 5.5 試圖修正這一點，但 Opus 4.6 作為純寫作模型依然無人能及。相關文章 Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Meta's AI agent Muse draws 500,000 users in a week along with claims it copied OpenClaw
items.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse picked up more than 500,000 users in its first week and hit number one in Apple's App Store. But Meta admits the product is "heavily inspired" by the open-source project OpenClaw, and some of the file names and contents are nearly identical. OpenAI is already discussing a response of its own. The article Meta's AI agent Muse draws 500,000 users in a week along with claims it copied OpenClaw appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Meta's 的 AI 代理 Muse 在推出第一週就獲得超過 50 萬名使用者，並登上 蘋果的 App Store 的第一名。但 Meta 坦承該產品是「深受」開源專案 OpenClaw 啟發，且部分檔名與內容幾乎完全相同。OpenAI 已經在討論其因應對策。相關文章 Meta's AI agent Muse draws 500,000 users in a week along with claims it copied OpenClaw 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data
items.summary: Basecamp Research has raised $140 million from investors including Nvidia and Anthropic's Anthology Fund. The London company trains AI models on genetic material from rainforests, oceans, and hot springs to design antibiotics and tools for cell therapies. In an interview with THE DECODER, CTO Philip Lorenz explains why biology is a far bigger problem for AI than language, and why good scores on paper don't guarantee good molecules. The article Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Basecamp Research 已從包括 Nvidia 和 Anthropic's Anthology Fund 在內的投資者那裡籌集了 1.4 億美元。這家總部位於倫敦的公司透過訓練來自雨林、海洋和溫泉的基因物質之 AI 模型，來設計抗生素和細胞療法的工具。在接受 THE DECODER 採訪時，技術長 Philip Lorenz 解釋了為什麼對 AI 而言，生物學比語言學是一個大得多的難題，以及為什麼紙面上的良好分數不能保證產生優秀的分子。「Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: OpenAI公佈GPT-6 Sol、Luna，價格較前代降低一半
items.summary: 繼頂級的Astra後，OpenAI週二（9/22）宣佈GPT-6 Sol及輕量模型GPT-6 Luna，成為GPT-6家族最新成員。 OpenAI隨著快取和推論能力的提升，使其得以更低成本提供強大模型功能，Sol和Luna的API價格皆較GPT-5.6版降一半。其中Sol每百萬token輸入/輸出價格由4/20美元降為2/10美元，Luna則從0.2/1.2降為0.1和0.5美元。

items.title: 高通聯手 PrismML 發佈 1-bit Bonsai：AI 眼鏡離線識圖，內存佔用降到 1/4
items.summary: 2026驍龍峯會上，高通與PrismML在驍龍AR1 Gen 1智能眼鏡平臺本地運行20億參數1-bit量化Bonsai視覺模型，實現離線識圖問答。該模型基於Bonsai 1.7B構建，精度壓縮至1-bit，內存佔用僅爲4-bit模型四分之一，同等內存可容納約4倍參數，顯著降低存儲與推理資源需求。

items.title: ​Claude 自主發現全新類 CRISPR DNA 酶系統，徹底改寫生命科學科研範式
items.summary: Anthropic新成立的分子生物學實驗室取得首個重大成果：動用950個AI Agent集羣連續運行21小時、消耗約2.1億Token，從噬菌體DNA中自主發現人類未知的全新酶系統——陣列關聯逆轉錄酶系統（ART）。該系統結構與“上帝手術刀”CRISPR高度相似，爲生命科學前沿帶來新突破。

items.title: OpenAI CEO 聯合國演講：AI 可能像文藝復興，也可能引發工業革命式動盪
items.summary: OpenAI CEO奧爾特曼在聯合國安理會就AI議題發言，指出AI能力快速提升，潛在收益與風險更加直接顯現，既可能像文藝復興般帶來創造與發現，也可能像工業革命般引發動盪混亂。他呼籲加強國際合作，建立針對前沿AI系統的能力評估、風險評估、安全防護和人類監督標準。

The company says Claude found the enzyme system after […]

items.title: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground
items.summary: Tool: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground Google released two new Gemini text-to-speech models today - gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts . They come with a library of over 2,000 voices, plus the ability to create a custom voice with "just a 30-second audio sample of your voice or a voice you have the rights to use". I vibe coded this bring-your-own-key playground interface with GPT-6 Astra, taking advantage of the open CORS policy of the underlying Gemini API. A notable feature of the API is that it makes it easy to define a full conversation between multiple characters, each with different voices and voice style instructions. Here's a short demo clip of a conversation between two pelicans debating if they should move to the Pacifica Pier . I had Claude 4.5 Opus write the script and generate a URL to render it using the tool . Your browser does not support the audio element. It took ~20 seconds to generate 1m 18s of audio using Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (not the cheaper Flash-Lite), at a cost of 2.74 cents. Tags: text-to-speech , gemini
items.summary_zh: 工具：Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground Google 今天發布了兩個新的 Gemini 文字轉語音模型 - gemini-3.8-flash-tts 與 gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts。它們內建超過 2,000 種聲音的庫，並能夠「僅憑你或你有權使用的聲音的 30 秒音訊樣本」來建立自訂聲音。我使用 GPT-6 Astra 以 vibe coding 方式編寫了這個自備金鑰（bring-your-own-key）的遊樂場介面，充分利用了底層 Gemini API 的開放 CORS 政策。該 API 的一個顯著特點是，它能輕鬆定義多個角色之間的完整對話，每個角色都有不同的聲音和語音風格指令。以下是一段簡短的示範剪輯，內容是兩隻鵜鶘在辯論是否應該搬到太平洋碼頭（Pacifica Pier）。我讓 Claude 4.5 Opus 撰寫劇本並產生一個網址，以便用該工具進行算繪。你的瀏覽器不支援音訊元素。使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS（而非較便宜的 Flash-Lite）產生 1 分 18 秒的音訊大約花費了 20 秒，成本為 2.74 美分。標籤：text-to-speech, gemini

items_ai.title: 提示詞注入仍難可靠防範，澳洲通訊局公佈AI代理許可權控管原則
items_ai.summary: 澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）發布代理型AI安全指引，警告目前仍沒有完全可靠的技術方法可以防範大型語言模型（LLM）將外部內容解讀成指令的提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）。ASD因此建議企業在部署代理型AI時，不應只依賴LLM本身的安全機制，還需限制AI代理存取資源的範圍及可執行的操作，降低提示詞注入造成的影響。

items_ai.title: ChatGPT Voice gets closer to "Her" with email, calendar, and Slack access
items_ai.summary: ChatGPT Voice now runs on OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna models and can tap into plugins like email, calendar, and Slack. Users can manage appointments, send emails, or build websites just by talking. The update moves OpenAI closer to the everyday AI assistant Sam Altman has long compared to the one in the sci-fi film "Her." The article ChatGPT Voice gets closer to "Her" with email, calendar, and Slack access appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: Google's new Flash TTS models let you design AI voices from scratch using text descriptions
items_ai.summary: Google is introducing two new text-to-speech models, Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS, which support more than 100 languages. Flash TTS can create new voices from text descriptions, and both models let users add stage directions to individual lines and generate two-voice dialogue from a single script. A voice cloning feature can build a voice profile from a 30-second sample. The article Google's new Flash TTS models let you design AI voices from scratch using text descriptions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 正在推出兩個全新的文字轉語音模型：Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 與 Flash-Lite TTS，支援超過 100 種語言。Flash TTS 可以根據文字描述建立新的聲音，且這兩個模型都允許使用者在個別行中加入舞臺指示，並從單一劇本產生雙人對話。聲音複製功能則能透過 30 秒的樣本建立聲音設定檔。相關文章 Google's new Flash TTS models let you design AI voices from scratch using text descriptions 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter
items_ai.summary: Anthropic employee Jackson Kernion explains why newer Claude models write so oddly. Optimizing for math, code, and technical explanations aimed at other AI models has created a style that sounds like "overly-dense info dumps" to humans. Opus 5.5 tries to fix this, but Opus 4.6 remains unmatched as a pure writing model. The article Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 員工 Jackson Kernion 解釋了為什麼較新的 Claude 模型寫作風格如此奇特。為了針對其他 AI 模型進行數學、程式碼和技術解釋的最佳化，造就了一種對人類而言聽起來像是「過度密集的資訊傾倒」的風格。Opus 5.5 試圖修正這一點，但 Opus 4.6 作為純寫作模型依然無人能及。相關文章 Anthropic engineer explains why Claude's writing got worse although the model got smarter 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Meta's AI agent Muse draws 500,000 users in a week along with claims it copied OpenClaw
items_ai.summary: Meta's AI agent Muse picked up more than 500,000 users in its first week and hit number one in Apple's App Store. But Meta admits the product is "heavily inspired" by the open-source project OpenClaw, and some of the file names and contents are nearly identical. OpenAI is already discussing a response of its own. The article Meta's AI agent Muse draws 500,000 users in a week along with claims it copied OpenClaw appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Meta's 的 AI 代理 Muse 在推出第一週就獲得超過 50 萬名使用者，並登上 蘋果的 App Store 的第一名。但 Meta 坦承該產品是「深受」開源專案 OpenClaw 啟發，且部分檔名與內容幾乎完全相同。OpenAI 已經在討論其因應對策。相關文章 Meta's AI agent Muse draws 500,000 users in a week along with claims it copied OpenClaw 首次發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data
items_ai.summary: Basecamp Research has raised $140 million from investors including Nvidia and Anthropic's Anthology Fund. The London company trains AI models on genetic material from rainforests, oceans, and hot springs to design antibiotics and tools for cell therapies. In an interview with THE DECODER, CTO Philip Lorenz explains why biology is a far bigger problem for AI than language, and why good scores on paper don't guarantee good molecules. The article Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Basecamp Research 已從包括 Nvidia 和 Anthropic's Anthology Fund 在內的投資者那裡籌集了 1.4 億美元。這家總部位於倫敦的公司透過訓練來自雨林、海洋和溫泉的基因物質之 AI 模型，來設計抗生素和細胞療法的工具。在接受 THE DECODER 採訪時，技術長 Philip Lorenz 解釋了為什麼對 AI 而言，生物學比語言學是一個大得多的難題，以及為什麼紙面上的良好分數不能保證產生優秀的分子。「Inside Basecamp Research, the AI startup turning evolution into training data」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.summary: 繼頂級的Astra後，OpenAI週二（9/22）宣佈GPT-6 Sol及輕量模型GPT-6 Luna，成為GPT-6家族最新成員。 OpenAI隨著快取和推論能力的提升，使其得以更低成本提供強大模型功能，Sol和Luna的API價格皆較GPT-5.6版降一半。其中Sol每百萬token輸入/輸出價格由4/20美元降為2/10美元，Luna則從0.2/1.2降為0.1和0.5美元。

items_ai.title: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground
items_ai.summary: Tool: Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground Google released two new Gemini text-to-speech models today - gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts . They come with a library of over 2,000 voices, plus the ability to create a custom voice with "just a 30-second audio sample of your voice or a voice you have the rights to use". I vibe coded this bring-your-own-key playground interface with GPT-6 Astra, taking advantage of the open CORS policy of the underlying Gemini API. A notable feature of the API is that it makes it easy to define a full conversation between multiple characters, each with different voices and voice style instructions. Here's a short demo clip of a conversation between two pelicans debating if they should move to the Pacifica Pier . I had Claude 4.5 Opus write the script and generate a URL to render it using the tool . Your browser does not support the audio element. It took ~20 seconds to generate 1m 18s of audio using Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (not the cheaper Flash-Lite), at a cost of 2.74 cents. Tags: text-to-speech , gemini
items_ai.summary_zh: 工具：Gemini 3.8 TTS Playground Google 今天發布了兩個新的 Gemini 文字轉語音模型 - gemini-3.8-flash-tts 與 gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts。它們內建超過 2,000 種聲音的庫，並能夠「僅憑你或你有權使用的聲音的 30 秒音訊樣本」來建立自訂聲音。我使用 GPT-6 Astra 以 vibe coding 方式編寫了這個自備金鑰（bring-your-own-key）的遊樂場介面，充分利用了底層 Gemini API 的開放 CORS 政策。該 API 的一個顯著特點是，它能輕鬆定義多個角色之間的完整對話，每個角色都有不同的聲音和語音風格指令。以下是一段簡短的示範剪輯，內容是兩隻鵜鶘在辯論是否應該搬到太平洋碼頭（Pacifica Pier）。我讓 Claude 4.5 Opus 撰寫劇本並產生一個網址，以便用該工具進行算繪。你的瀏覽器不支援音訊元素。使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS（而非較便宜的 Flash-Lite）產生 1 分 18 秒的音訊大約花費了 20 秒，成本為 2.74 美分。標籤：text-to-speech, gemini

items_ai.title: Inferact's TPU megakernel hits 709 tokens per second on Kimi K3
items_ai.summary: Inferact reports 709 tokens per second on 16 TPU v7 chips, versus 452 on 16 GB200 GPUs, in a low-concurrency speculative-decoding test. Co-founder Woosuk Kwon, a vLLM co-creator, helped build the open-source kernel.
items_ai.summary_zh: 在低併發猜測解碼測試中，Inferact 報告在 16 個 TPU v7 晶片上達到每秒 709 個 Token，而 16 個 GB200 GPU 則是 452 個。共同創辦人、vLLM 共同創造者 Woosuk Kwon 協助打造了這個開源核心。
